title: Decide whether Windows is a target and drop the installer dependencies if not
notes: electron-squirrel-startup, its types and the Forge makers are never run; CI is Ubuntu only and never runs make. Drop them and the win32 branches, or add a Windows CI job. (docs/review/2026-11-01.md D2)

comments.body: Answered by PR #191 (Sana, merged): Windows is a target. The installer dependencies stay. A Windows CI job is its own card.
